areas.t: Sunday, November 8: Moderate southwesterly winds will gradually transport regional pollutants into northeastern Ohio. In addition, a ridge of high pressure aloft will hinder mixing early in the day. However, low pollutant carryover will allow AQI levels to remain high-Good.  Monday, November 9: Mode

Current Conditions (Friday afternoon, 11/6/2026): A reinforcing cold front is crossing through western Pennsylvania this afternoon, bringing a shifting wind direction out of the northwest and isolated showers. The change in wind is creating good air quality for fine particulate matter (PM2.5) today.
